meta.title: Update tpc-ds IR outputs and improve union_all
meta.body_summary: Optimize union_all by preallocating slice space and regenerate tpc-ds IR golden files for queries q1–q9.

perf_labels.notes: Codex optimized union_all with slice preallocation in vm.go; no reviews, self-merged within 21 seconds.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7762 changed lines, this appears large, but the vast majority (7756) are regenerated tpc-ds golden file updates; the actual optimization is 6 lines in vm.go preallocating slice space. The outcome (self-merge with no review) aligns with a small, low-risk performance improvement in a trusted codebase.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments; PR self-merged by author.
review_details.performance_claim: Union_all slice preallocation improves performance by reducing allocations.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small slice preallocation in VM requires no deep domain expertise and no benchmark evidence; accepted with no review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or performance data; only narrative claim of preallocation optimization.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions identified; no review process.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, the union_all function now preallocates the result slice using make([]Value, 0, totalLen) to avoid repeated slice growth, and regenerated tpc-ds IR golden output files q1–q9 accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The bulk of changes are in tpc-ds IR golden files, reflecting different ordering/numbering due to the VM change.
change_trajectory: Single commit: vm.go union_all preallocation + regenerate all tpc-ds golden outputs.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened and merged within 21 seconds by author without any review or comment activity.
